intro.title: Build date range picker logic
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build the logic for a date range picker, a common UI component that lets users select a start and end date. You will learn to manage two date values in state and ensure the end date is never earlier than the start date. The core programming concepts involve using JavaScript's Date object and conditional logic to validate the date range. You'll work with state variables, event handlers, and basic date comparisons to create a functional and user-friendly component.
intro.usecase: Date range pickers are essential UI components in modern web applications, particularly in data-heavy interfaces like analytics dashboards, financial platforms, and e-commerce systems. Developers implement them in reporting tools to filter time-series data, in booking systems for selecting travel dates, and in admin panels for filtering logs or transactions. These components appear in forms, filter panels, and modal dialogs where users need to specify start and end dates for queries. Mastering this logic enables you to build intuitive date selection experiences that are fundamental to data exploration and user workflows.
